data.name: Nuri
data.gender_notes: Nuri is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nur’, meaning ‘light’ or ‘luminous’. In Islamic tradition, ‘nur’ signifies the light of God or the light of guidance. The name Nuri carries the meaning “Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuri usually hope their child will grow to embody light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual enlightenment and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Nuri belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuri total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
